# Overview of this document {.unnumbered}

This online document is a joint output of the ARDC "Ecosystem Indicators Workflows" (EIW) project and the ARC Industry Laureate Fellowship Project "Foundations for leading the nature positive ecosystem conservation agenda".

- Selected palustrine wetland and other transitional ecosystems of Tasmania.

## Reproducibility statement

This resource uses Bash, R and Python for most steps of data download, preparation and analysis. All steps are documented using Jupyter notebooks and quarto. This resource is designed to be reproducible, with instructions for data download and code execution provided in the relevant sections. The data used in this resource is publicly available, and the code is open source. Instructions for setting up the environment and running the code and notes on the implementation of FAIR principles are provided in the relevant sections at the end of this document.
